trajectory.title: 末端实际与参考轨迹
trajectory.caption: World XY/XZ paths of the actual flange and the recorded observer-evaluated approach reference, only while the approach reference is applicable. Equal spatial scales. S03 run P02; PREDICTION_REJECTED; actual interval 0.000–6.440 s; latch none; final window NOT_EVALUATED (full post-capture horizon absent). All recorded attempts are retained. Noisy capture compatibility is not established.

tracking.title: 末端轨迹跟踪误差
tracking.caption: Actual flange minus the recorded observer-evaluated approach reference during approach: world position components, position norm, and SO(3) rotation error. No inactive post-latch reference is extended. This observer-sampled reference is not a freshly issued HQP task command at every servo tick. S03 run P02; PREDICTION_REJECTED; actual interval 0.000–6.440 s; latch none; final window NOT_EVALUATED (full post-capture horizon absent). All recorded attempts are retained.
